trigger.plain: An hourly candle closes above yesterday's high, the hook out of the pullback.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below ma_20, or structure_shift turns BEARISH_CHOCH.
decisions.reason: Retracement (C2). H1 swing_class HH/HL, 9>21, 2.2% under the last swing high; W HH/HL. D swing_class LH/LL keeps it a wait for the hook, not a buy now.

decisions.wrong_if: Wrong to stand aside if a dip toward ma_20 holds and hooks, giving a retracement I can classify.
decisions.reason: No setup type (R1). D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 3.32, extended continuation with no pullback to buy. Not a veto.

trigger.plain: An hourly candle closes above yesterday's high once the pullback holds the broken pivot.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below structure_shift_ref, the broken pivot high, or the big-volume bar is fully given back.
decisions.reason: Retracement after a break (C2). D swing_class HH/HL above EMA9; H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 35.4 is the live pullback. W and D momentum flag true. Climax risk (C11/C19) keeps it WAIT.

decisions.wrong_if: Wrong to stand aside if a pullback holds ma_20 and hooks, giving a higher low to buy.
decisions.reason: No setup type (R1). D swing_class HH/HL but dist_to_20bar_high_pct 1.15: a push at the high, no higher low formed. Not a veto.

decisions.wrong_if: Wrong to stand aside if a dry retest of structure_shift_ref holds and hooks.
decisions.reason: No setup type (R1). D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.49: at the high, no retracement; contraction breakout needs bar_range_history, NOT_SERVED.

decisions.wrong_if: Wrong to stand aside if a dip toward ma_20 holds and hooks, giving a retracement to classify.
decisions.reason: No setup type (R1). D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.45: at the high with no higher low to buy; no range series for a contraction call. Not a veto.

declarations: setup_type: retracement (C2) on every SUPPORT; no test, climax or breakout called. ABSTAIN means no fit to the four (R1), not a veto (R27).
adx: NOT_SERVED (C7, C8); stochastic_kd: NOT_SERVED (C6); bar_range_history: NOT_SERVED (C12, C13); market_breadth: OUT_OF_SERVED_SCOPE (C16).
n_day_extreme: MTF swing lines + dist_to_20bar_high_pct (substitute, C3/C4).
